bio: Lothac is one of very few to undertake the Trial of the Ram, an old and painful Eldrin ritual. The magic made him as stubborn as the Trial’s namesake, but it was conviction he needed – he feared the temptations of evil more than anything else. Well, he fears them no longer. He destroys them instead.
